claims.claim: urllib3 provides the proxy_ssl_context parameter for configuring TLS settings used when connecting to an HTTPS proxy.
claims.citation: Configure proxy CA certificates and client certificates in `proxy_ssl_context`

claims.claim: urllib3's HTTPResponse.stream() method can read response bodies that use chunked transfer encoding.
claims.citation: `HTTPResponse.stream()` and `read_chunked()` could buffer a chunk-size line of unbounded length in memory.

claims.claim: urllib3 supports decoding deflate-encoded response bodies.
claims.citation: Chunked Deflate streaming could enter an infinite loop.

claims.claim: urllib3 2.8.0 requires all users with HTTPS proxies to change their configurations.
claims.citation: Configurations relying on that behavior may require changes.

claims.claim: The unbounded chunk-size line buffering in urllib3 could cause out-of-memory crashes.
claims.citation: `HTTPResponse.stream()` and `read_chunked()` could buffer a chunk-size line of unbounded length in memory.

claims.claim: The urllib3 TLS configuration for HTTPS proxies was always ignored in favor of the destination settings before version 2.8.0.
claims.citation: The TLS configuration for HTTPS proxies could be ignored or overridden.
